title: 第10幕末日游走第11幕小野怪大神技
content_zh:
第10幕 末日……游走？
(走过路过
末日使者的几个技能都相当的不错。
1技能是吞噬。在之前版本被加强之后1级便可以吞噬野区所有级别的野怪并且拥有这些野怪的技能，消化掉吞噬的野怪之后还能够获得额外的金钱，既可以为自己提供多种次级技能选择丰富了发展路线又可以增快刷钱刷经验的速度，是看起来不起眼但各方面而言都相当强力的一个技能，末日使者的十八般武艺大半是靠它来实现的。
2技能焦土。以烈焰覆盖大地，焦土会对其上的敌方单位造成伤害，对末日使者却有医疗效果。开启后，末日使者周围地面变为焦土，焦土随着末日使者一起移动，并提升末日使者16%的移动速度。
虽然技能的伤害算不上高，最多只能说聊胜于无，但这是一个大范围的群伤技能，可以给自己加血并能增加移动速度的属性也注定这是一个相当实用的技能，无论是追杀还是逃命都不错。
3技能死亡，也就是常说的等级炮。打散目标部分的灵魂，造成伤害和0.01秒的晕眩。如果目标的等级是特别数字的倍数，将造成最大生命值20%的额外伤害。
作为末日使者主要的输出技能，正常情况下的死亡伤害实在算不上出色，不附带控制效果的单体最高275的伤害数值算是相当低了，可是这个技能有一个所谓的幸运数字判断机制，1级是6的倍数，升级后依次变成5，4，3的倍数，一旦敌人英雄的等级正好处于幸运数字将会遭受额外伤害，买一赠一一下顶两下。
末日使者最后的大招末日则是他的绝对核心技能。对目标施予末日的惩罚，目标将不能使用技能和道具，并不断地受到伤害，持续时间15秒。这个技能虽然对敌人造成的直接伤害不像恶魔巫师或者火女莉娜的大招那样强悍，可是加起来的话也不算低，1级每秒30点伤害，总计450点的伤害，3级每秒70点伤害，总计1050点伤害。
但是末日这个技能的核心并非伤害，最让人感到恐惧的是这个技能长时间无视bkb效果的禁魔和全dota唯一的禁物品栏的能力！这个能力让几乎所有英雄闻末日而色变，谁也不愿意自己摊上这个倒霉的技能。
禁止技能的沉默效果倒还没什么，禁止物品栏就惨了，眼睁睁看着满格的大魔棒就是不能用，羊刀、吹风、红杖甚至就连使用回城卷轴逃跑都做不到。
正是由于这个极度恶心人的技能，末日使者经常被称呼为其他英雄的“爸爸”，一旦被盯上便只能挨打没法还手。
更加凶残的是目前版本末日技能再次得到了加强，在经过了阿哈利姆神杖的加强之后，只要末日使者在附近，那么末日效果便不会读秒，永久持续直到敌人死亡或者和末日使者脱离接触之后再开始读秒。
经过了这么一加强，原本的末日爸爸直接跨越等级进阶成了单挑所向无敌的末日爷爷乃至祖宗。
记得以前有一次邢辰用末日使者的时候正巧碰上对方的大后期虚空假面正站在鸟边整理装备。许是身上散件太多装备栏不好弄，鸟里装得东西也多格子不够，他便将合成狂战斧的装备一件件扔在地上准备调整一番装备栏后合成。
正巧这个时候邢辰的末日使者突然出现了，抬手便是一个末日上给了虚空假面，然后悲剧的大后期眼睁睁看着自己的装备被末日使者席卷而走却因为物品栏被禁用怎么样捡不起来，不但将近20分钟的钱白打了，还顺便还搭上了一条性命，简直欲哭无泪亏本到了姥姥家。
在dota的地图中一共有上中下三条出兵路线，其中中路双方部队行走距离相同，没有优劣之分，而上路兵线交汇点在天灾上路第一座外围防御塔下，天灾方的英雄容易躲进防御塔下获得支援，是天灾的优势路近卫的劣势路，下路则刚好相反。
除了这三路之外，双方还各自有自己的野区可以打里面的野怪获得经验和金钱，但是由于初期英雄级别低，面对野怪很难打得过，所以只有少数英雄可以在初期利用野区的资源，而邢辰控制的末日使者恰恰便是能够在早期打野的英雄之一。
邢辰的英雄刚刚出来耳边便响起了暗痕的声音：“你走中吧，中路让给那些不会玩的家伙们实在浪费了！”
现实中的dota－x也是有内置语音通讯系统的，所以刚刚暗痕的通讯并没有让邢辰太过吃惊，只不过这个游戏空间中的语音因为是直接通过脑波传输，所以实在太过清晰了完全没有dota－x那种模糊的电子味，让他仓促之间还是有些不习惯。

稍微研究了一下邢辰便明白这里的语音通讯的使用方法了，立刻向暗痕回道：“我不走中，让给他们吧，我和冰女看看能不能游走杀人，不能就打野。”
“你和冰女游走！？”暗痕有些发愣，在dota中游走是很正常的一件事情，同样也是一件很需要技术的事情，虽然让那三个恐怕就连地图都摸不熟的人游走实在强人所难，由邢辰这个“高手”游走是没问题的。
但是……末日使者这个英雄来游走他倒还真没怎么见过，因为末日使者到6拥有大招之后会有一个质变，所以一般来说这个英雄都是会以尽快到6为目的。
最主要的是末日使者前期没有控制技又贫蓝，一个技能下去蓝条就得见底，和那些典型的游走者比起来实在不是一个适合前期游走的英雄。
冰女这个英雄倒是个游走的好选择，但是使用她的那个女孩……能指望得上才怪！
那么……这个1600分的家伙到底想要做什么？
暗痕不禁疑惑起来。
content_en:
Act 10 Doomsday... Wandering?
(passed by
Several of Doombringer's skills are quite good.
The 1st skill is Devour. After the previous version was strengthened, at level 1, you can devour all levels of wild monsters in the wild area and possess the skills of these wild monsters. After digesting the devoured wild monsters, you can also get extra money. This can not only provide you with a variety of secondary skill options, enrich your development route, but also increase the speed of earning money and experience. It is a skill that looks inconspicuous but is quite powerful in all aspects. Most of the Doomsday Bringer's eighteen martial arts are achieved by it.
2 skills scorched earth. Covering the ground with flames, the scorched earth will cause damage to enemy units on it, but has a medical effect on the bringer of doom. After it is turned on, the ground around the Doombringer turns into scorched earth. The scorched earth moves with the Doombringer and increases the Doombringer's movement speed by 16%.
Although the damage of the skill is not high, it can only be said to be better than nothing at best, but it is a large-scale group damage skill. The attributes that can increase one's blood and increase movement speed also make it a very practical skill, good for chasing and escaping.
Skill 3 is death, which is often called level gun. Disperses part of the target's soul, causing damage and stunning for 0.01 seconds. If the target's level is a multiple of the special number, 20% of the maximum health will be dealt additional damage.
As the main output skill of the Doombringer, the death damage under normal circumstances is really not outstanding. The maximum damage value of 275 for a single target without control effects is quite low. However, this skill has a so-called lucky number judgment mechanism. Level 1 is a multiple of 6. After upgrading, it becomes a multiple of 5, 4, and 3. Once the enemy hero's level is exactly at the lucky number, he will suffer additional damage. Buy one and get one for two.
The Doomsday Bringer's final ultimate move, Doom, is his absolute core skill. Inflict doomsday punishment on the target. The target will not be able to use skills and props, and will continue to be damaged for 15 seconds. Although the direct damage this skill causes to the enemy is not as powerful as the ultimate move of the Demon Wizard or Fire Girl Lina, it is not low in total. Level 1 is 30 damage per second, a total of 450 points of damage, and level 3 is 70 damage per second, a total of 1050 points of damage.
But the core of the Doomsday skill is not damage. The most frightening thing is that this skill has the ability to ignore BKB effects for a long time and is the only forbidden item slot in Dota! This ability makes almost all heroes pale when they hear the doomsday, and no one is willing to end up with this unlucky skill.
The silence effect of banned skills is not that great, but the banning of the inventory is miserable. The big magic wand with a full grid cannot be used, and the sheep knife, hair dryer, red staff, and even the town return scroll cannot be used to escape.
It is precisely because of this extremely disgusting skill that Doombringer is often called the "dad" of other heroes. Once targeted, he can only be beaten without being able to fight back.
What's even more cruel is that the current version of the doomsday skill has been strengthened again. After being strengthened by Aghanim's Scepter, as long as the doomsday bringer is nearby, the doomsday effect will not count down and will last forever until the enemy dies or breaks away from the doomsday bringer and then starts counting down.
After such a strengthening, the original Doomsday Dad directly jumped across the levels and advanced to become the Doomsday Grandpa and even the ancestor who was invincible in single combat.
I remember that one time when Xing Chen used Doombringer, he happened to encounter the opponent's late-stage Mask of the Void, who was standing next to the bird arranging equipment. Maybe it was because there were too many parts on him and it was difficult to get rid of the equipment slots, and there were not enough slots to put things in the bird, so he threw the equipment to be combined into the Battle Fury Ax on the ground piece by piece, preparing to adjust the equipment slots before merging it.
It just so happened that Xing Chen's doomsday messenger suddenly appeared. He raised his hand and a doomsday messenger came to him.Mask of the Void, and then in the tragic late stage, I watched my equipment being swept away by the Doomsday Herald but couldn't pick it up because the inventory was disabled. Not only was nearly 20 minutes of money spent in vain, but also a life was lost by the way. I just couldn't help but cry without tears when I arrived at my grandma's house at a loss.
In the Dota map, there are a total of three troop dispatch routes, upper, middle and lower. Among them, the distance traveled by the troops on both sides of the middle lane is the same, and there is no distinction between superior and inferior. The intersection point of the upper lane is under the first peripheral defense tower on the upper road of the natural disaster. The heroes of the natural disaster side can easily hide under the defense tower to get support. It is the advantageous route of the natural disaster and the disadvantageous route of the guards, while the bottom lane is just the opposite.
In addition to these three routes, both sides also have their own wild areas where they can fight the wild monsters to gain experience and money. However, due to the low level of the heroes in the early stage, it is difficult to defeat the wild monsters, so only a few heroes can make use of the resources in the wild area in the early stage, and the Doombringer controlled by Xing Chen is exactly one of the heroes who can fight in the jungle in the early stage.
As soon as Xing Chen's hero came out, An Hen's voice sounded in his ears: "You should go to the middle. It would be a waste to leave the middle to those guys who don't know how to play!"
In reality, Dota-X also has a built-in voice communication system, so Xing Chen was not too surprised by the communication just now. However, because the voice in this game space was transmitted directly through brain waves, it was too clear and did not have the fuzzy electronic flavor of Dota-X, which made him a little unaccustomed to it in a hurry.
After a little research, Xing Chen understood how to use the voice communication here, and immediately replied to Anhen: "I won't hit the target, let them do it. Ice Girl and I will see if we can roam and kill. If not, we will go to the wild."
"You and the Ice Girl are wandering!?" An Hen was a little dazed. Wandering in Dota is a normal thing, and it is also a very technical thing. Although it is difficult for those three people to wander, who may not even be familiar with the map, Xing Chen, a "master", has no problem wandering.
But... he has never seen the hero Doombringer roam around very often, because there will be a qualitative change after Doombringer reaches level 6 and has the ultimate move, so generally speaking, this hero aims to reach level 6 as soon as possible.
The most important thing is that Doombringer has no control skills in the early stage and is poor in mana. The mana bar will bottom out if he uses one skill. Compared with those typical roamers, he is really not a hero suitable for early stage roaming.
The hero Ice Girl is a good choice for roaming, but the girl who uses her... is weird to be able to count on her!
So...what does this guy with 1,600 points want to do?
An Hen couldn't help but become confused.
